name: 伙伴 GitHub
description: 显式选择伙伴 GitHub App 身份，操作指定 MontClip 仓库。Windows 使用 DPAPI，Linux 使用 Secret Service 加密保护凭据；不提供伙伴间强制身份隔离。
whenToUse: 伙伴通过自己的 GitHub App 操作各自获准仓库的 Issue、PR 和代码；ReviewInbox 可发 COMMENT、APPROVE、REQUEST_CHANGES 评审（主人 2026-11-15 决定）。

secretBindings.label: 伙伴 GitHub App 私钥（PEM）
secretBindings.hint: 只在设置页导入私钥时填写；导入后会自动清除。

tools.name: github_accounts
tools.description: 列出本机允许的 App 账号与凭据可读状态；名称标明预期/存储值，实时注册身份以 identity 回执为准。

tools.name: github_operations
tools.description: 读取可用操作及各操作参数格式；实际写操作前按该格式传参。

tools.name: github_import_key
tools.description: 按用户授权从明确的本机 PEM 文件导入 App 私钥；先验证真实 App 与安装范围，再由 Windows DPAPI 或 Linux Secret Service 加密保护。不要在参数中传私钥正文。

account.description: 伙伴账号别名；内置 bb/cindy/deja/dd/gg/jj/pg/qq/rea/video/vv/reviewinbox，另可在 scope-config.json 中配置新账号（如 ad）。

tools.name: github
tools.description: 使用显式App身份操作该账号已授权仓库。先用github_operations查询参数；写入须对应用户任务授权。不会回退共享gh登录；未知结果先读回，勿重复写。

account.description: 伙伴账号别名；内置 bb/cindy/deja/dd/gg/jj/pg/qq/rea/video/vv/reviewinbox，另可在 scope-config.json 中配置新账号（如 ad）。

repo.description: good-night-oppie 下的仓库名（不带 owner）；必须在配置名单中，否则返回 REPOSITORY_NOT_ALLOWED 且不执行。

tools.name: github_review_queue
tools.description: 自动评审队列：initialize只记录初始head；poll只读候选并对账；claim持有30分钟租约；finish必须验证真实review身份、head和标记。不得以完成标记替代真实评审。

tools.name: github_author_cue_plan
tools.description: 按BB规则计算作者提醒计划，不发送/不记录投递。输入须来自完整当前head快照及实际核验的承接来源；仅设置sourceVerified不足以证明核验。旧head、未到reportAt、重复cue抑制；归属不明交Deja，安全问题QQ。详见manual/author-cue-rules。

tools.name: inbox_service
tools.description: 管理插件拥有的隔离只读 Inbox 预览：启动、健康状态、停止。不会接管既有 Inbox，也不启用评审流水线。

items.name: agent-github
items.description: 伙伴身份选择、权限、PR评审及自动任务流程

items.name: oppie-github-work
items.description: Use a teammate's own Oppie GitHub App on its configured repositories; inspect identity and diagnose repository scope mismatches before performing GitHub work.

releaseNotes: 2026-11-15: Plugin settings page to add teammate GitHub Apps (name, slug, App ID, installation ID, role, allowed operations) and repositories; changes take effect on the next call without restart. Every save shows a host confirmation card with the full change and uses a revision check; an audit line is recorded. App private keys are entered only in the settings page secret field, verified against GitHub and stored with the existing DPAPI store. Configured accounts can never be admin or use QQ-only operations; ReviewInbox review events are unchanged (owner decision 2026-11-15). Builds on the 1.5.0-preview.8-seven-roles.2 all-repositories fix. settings.2 (QQ review 2026-11-16): the configuration file is signed with a DPAPI-sealed HMAC key and revision, read through the owner-only ACL check, so hand edits, replays and deletions fail closed; the confirmation card lists who can write an added repository; leftover key copies are removed; whenToUse states the current ReviewInbox review events. settings.3 (DD, europa): deployment.json is read on every call instead of once at worker start, so host account and automaticReviews edits apply without a restart; an invalid deployment.json fails closed. settings.4 (QQ review of #33): automaticReviews is read only at worker start; deleting both the configuration and its key after a save is refused instead of reverting to defaults; identity and github_accounts report the configuration source. settings.5 (BB, #29 vs #33): configured accounts can allow a broader App installation (execution tokens still exact), request contents:read unless they can write contents, may use the new reviewer role (read, comment, any review event), and the owner can make a repository unusable for an account in the settings page (role none). settings.6 (owner via QQ, 2026-11-16): permissions follow the App's actual installation for every account; a broader installation is accepted automatically (the settings.5 per-account switch is removed); execution tokens request the least the operation needs (contents:read unless it writes contents) and must equal the request; a missing installation level fails with INSTALLATION_PERMISSION_MISSING naming what to add and where; identity reports installed and missing permissions. errors.1 (PG design review #8 step 1, stacked on #33): every error result carries a plain Chinese reason and who should do what next; INSTALLATION_MISMATCH and APP_IDENTITY_MISMATCH name each failed check; configuration failures keep their reason; no security decision changed. REVIEW-INBOX-NETWORK.md lists where vendor/review-inbox connects.
